summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K reporting share repurchases under its ongoing buyback programme. Between 24 and 26 August 2026, the bank repurchased 12.8 million shares across four venues at average prices of €12.62–€12.71, bringing cumulative spend to €161.98 million, about 8.9% of the programme's maximum investment. The buyback, initiated 10 August 2026, has repurchased approximately 18% of outstanding shares since 2021. This is a routine issuer capital return, not a tender offer or special situation.
